verdict.rationale: Bolna supports event-driven automation via configurable webhooks fired on call completion (pushing data to CRM), call summaries/extractions triggered per call, and multi-step outreach workflows that chain voice calls, WhatsApp messages, API calls, waits and retries — effectively rule-like sequencing of actions on events. However there's no documented generic rule/condition engine (if-this-then-that logic) beyond these built-in workflow/webhook primitives. Missing for 10: an explicit conditional rule builder (arbitrary event->condition->action mapping beyond call-lifecycle webhooks and outreach sequences), independent/hands-on confirmation of automation reliability.
